errors.text: The proposed 5 meV/atom accuracy threshold is an order of magnitude looser than the approximately 0.5 meV/atom agreement required to resolve the target free-energy differences.
Training exclusively on liquid configurations cannot justify the claim that solid-phase sampling can be avoided when predicting a solid-liquid free-energy difference.

The falsification experiment does not directly distinguish genuine transferability from training-set leakage because it lacks a strictly held-out, out-of-distribution DFT test set and direct MTP-to-DFT energy-difference variance measurements.
The response does not identify the key TOR-TILD failure mode: slow or unreliable TI convergence when empirical reference potentials poorly overlap the multicomponent DFT phase-space distribution.
